name: MuslimInk
author: fiqsr
changelog_id: Pembaruan Auto-Updater: Unduhan bertahap chunked HTTP Range (64 KB) mengatasi batas socket buffer firmware ESP32
Indikator Progres: Tampilan langsung persentase (%), ukuran terunduh (KB), dan progress bar real-time
Perbaikan Tipografi: Judul modal saat gagal tidak lagi terpotong ('Pembaruan Gagal')
Perbaikan Tata Letak: Kalimat petunjuk Wi-Fi dibungkus rapi tanpa terpotong di border
Peningkatan Stabilitas: Mekanisme auto-retry 3x per-chunk jika koneksi Wi-Fi fluktuatif
Fitur Sebelumnya: Input Koordinat Manual (GPS), Kompas Kiblat & 6 Gaya Jam TrueType
changelog_en: Auto-Updater: 64 KB HTTP Range chunked downloader overcoming ESP32 firmware 128 KB buffer limit
Live Progress Indicator: Real-time percentage (%), downloaded KB / total KB, and animated progress bar
Typography Polish: Modal error title zero-truncation ('Update Failed')
Layout Polish: Proper multi-line text wrapping for Wi-Fi tips without border cut-offs
Reliability: 3x automatic chunk retry on unstable Wi-Fi connections
Previous Features: Manual GPS Coordinates Input, Qibla Compass & 6 TrueType Clock Styles
